description: The rows of the context menu a secondary press on selected text opens, for both targets: React's buildTextSelectionContextMenuItems and the wgpu shell's text-selection menu. A row without verb is the separator. editableOnly rows are offered for an editable target only, needsSelection rows are disabled without a selection. chord is the keybinding text each row shows; labelKey is the i18n key React reads and label carries the same texts for the shell (en, de).
